Sentence (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang product review event.

Sentence (English): To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): What are the features?
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Power Wash - 81 minutes. *
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Frees up time for other things. *
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): The wash cycle takes a while.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): My kitchen is quite small compared to most other kitchens. I've always thought it would be nice to have a dishwasher, but I've never really been able to bring myself to buy one. I finally got one through a trial program, and it's a whole new world. *My husband loves it. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. To summarize: First, as a family of three, we don't usually use large pots and pans, so a dishwasher for three was perfect. As I mentioned earlier, even if we had a large dishwasher, our kitchen is small, so there's no room for it. I didn't know what "no-installation" meant, but when I received it and tried to install it, it wasn't really a separate installation. All I had to do was plug in the drain and drain it into the sink. Turn it on, pour water into the inlet, and the machine notifies me when it's full. I'd love to fill it directly with water, but that's a long way off. What are the features? Standard wash - 64 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 70 degrees. This dishwasher uses the least amount of water and is ideal for regular post-meal cleaning. Power Wash - 81 minutes. *Wash 65 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Suitable for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco Wash - 80 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 65 degrees. Suitable for lightly soiled dishes that require simple cleaning. Quick Wash - 29 minutes. *Wash 55 degrees, rinse 60 degrees. Suitable for easy-to-clean dishes that don't require drying. Short wash time. Steam Sterilization - 64 minutes. *Wash 50 degrees, rinse 72 degrees. Steam sterilization is possible, making it ideal for dishes that require sterilization, such as baby bottles. *Uses 5L of water and 6g of detergent, but using the right amount should be sufficient. My thoughts on using Auntie Dishwasher. Pros: *Cleans well. *Saves water. *Frees up time for other things. *Pretty design. *Electricity bills are lower than expected (personal opinion). Cons: *Can't accommodate large dishes. *The price of the special detergent. *The wash cycle takes a while. Bottom line: there are people who never use it, but there are definitely people who only use it once. I finally understand why people use it. I received the product as part of a product review group, but I'm honestly the type to write honest reviews. (They used a blindfold.) It's a whole new world. It's supposed to be for three people, but I think it would be great for two. A single person would be able to easily wash the dishes. The price is also reasonable, so I recommend it. If you're looking for a dishwasher, buy it. It'll open up a whole new world. You'll wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. I'm very satisfied and recommend it. Sentence (English): I am so pleased with my new Samsung dishwasher with StormWash+ with Smart Dry.
Comments (English): [ Horrible ] || ---------------- || I am so pleased with my new Samsung dishwasher with StormWash+ with Smart Dry. It has a beautiful fingerprint resistant stainless steel finish on the exterior but it also has a clean and shiny, stainless steel interior. The namesake feature, StormWash+, beautifully cleans even the dirtiest of dishes. Another one of the many features I love about my new dishwasher is the fact at 42dBA, you can barely hear it while it's in use. I have an open concept floorplan and used to always hear my old dishwasher gurgling and swishing along during the wash cycles, not so with my new Samsung! I've questioned if the dishwashing cycle was interrupted, went to check on it and the dishwasher was functioning perfectly, but so quiet you can barely hear it, what a treat. You can see on the control panel the amount of time left in the wash/dry cycle and there are also three led lights that let you know if the dishwasher is in the wash, rinse or dry mode. When you connect your dishwasher to the Samsung SmartThings application there's no need to check on your super quiet dishwasher. The SmartThings app give you the ability to start, pause, stop, etc. remotely from your phone and if you like, it will alert you when your dishwashing cycle is complete. I love having a third rack at the top level to place the odd sized kitchen utensils such as spatulas, whisks, bottle openers and well as the tops to plastic wear. The center rack is easily adjustable up or down to help accommodate fitting more in the dishwasher, especially helpful when you have taller items like pitchers or large frying pans. The Smart Dry function with the AutoRelease Door system is yet another feature I love about my new dishwasher. Towards the end of the drying cycle the door to the dishwasher automatically pops open approximately 3 inches to allow for air circulation and to better aid in drying and it's energy saving to boot. All in all, I'm very pleased with my selection of this Samsung dishwasher and I'm going to look to Samsung when purchasing a new range later this year.

Comments (English): [ luxury level machine at great price ] || ---------------- || Feb 2023, I ordered & paid deposit Oct 2021, waiting for Bosch & everyone else to get parts needed for building machines. Worth the wait. Friends with Bosch and reviews online are right. great dishwasher! Replaced a KitchenAid. Everything comes clean on Auto cycle, is very quiet. Love 3rd rack for chopsticks, measuring cups, cooking utensils, small lightweight plastic and small ramekins or sauce dishes. Wish their User Guide had drawings and explanations of parts. Was left with the round sprayer attachment, loose, no explanation of what it is. Installer didn't tell me about it. And if I sell the house, new owner would be mystified. Had to search Bosch site for a while and watch a video that explained how to attach it for cleaning very large items with upper rack removed. Please just add a page to the Quick Start Guide.

I like being able to adjust setting on how much rinse aid get used. I'm transitioning from pods to powder because we have soft water. I wish I could see the time on the progress of the cycle I'm using. The red light that shines on the floor is really nice. I wish it showed different for different parts of the cycle. I thought it was going to do that. Make sure and print out the owners manual online because you will need it.

Sentence (English): It was a toss-up between a similar spec Miele G7000 series or the Bosch Series 8 as I had to replace a >10yo Dishlex dishwasher that died midway through a washing cycle.
Comments (English): [ It's a dishwasher - it gets the job done!  ] || ---------------- || It was a toss-up between a similar spec Miele G7000 series or the Bosch Series 8 as I had to replace a >10yo Dishlex dishwasher that died midway through a washing cycle. The Bosch's far more flexible bottom and middle racks, with the ability to flatten some sections, were a winner for me as I could place large pots into the bottom tray. I've had to purchase the vario cutlery tray to free up the bottom tray to create additional useable space - not a big issue, but having the ability to organise and place cutlery on a tray suited my lifestyle vs using a cutlery basket - means less possibility of stabbing your hands or being poked by forks and knives. Whilst Miele has a similar ability to change the height of the racks, the ability to modify the interior and flatten sections to cater for odd-shaped kitchenware items was the winning factor in selecting Bosch over Miele. The installers from Appliance Online were professionals. The installer, a Frenchman, was super friendly and took the time to explain the various functions of the Serie 8 Dishwasher. The wi-fi option is helpful, allowing me to remotely turn on and off and amend the multiple options, such as setting the dishwasher's water sensors to measure water turbidity and providing the dishwasher with an automated approach to washing mixed loads of kitchenware.So far, the dishwasher has met my expectations, minus purchasing the vario cutlery tray accessory to replace the current third shelf. Dishes, pots, cups and cutlery have all come out sparkling clean and dry. It helps to use quality dishwashing tabs, like Finish Ultimate Pro, to give your kitchenware the best clean and shine. I wanted to like the Miele, but the sheer flexibility of the Bosch line of dishwashers won me over. Time will tell on the longevity of this product, but so far, I'm impressed with this dishwasher and its build quality.

Sentence (English): I thought it was 3-tier but it's 2-tier.
Comments (English): I thought it was 3-tier but it's 2-tier. I like the height adjustment of the shelves the most. This is my first LG after Miele for 12 people. The only thing that's not good compared to Miele is this. After washing, Miele's door is hung somewhere after the automatic door opening. So I can tell right away whether I washed it or not. But LG's door opens and the push mechanism disappears, so I don't know whether I washed it or not, so I just turn it on in the morning. My husband and I are both busy, so we can't talk in the morning, and when one of us goes to work, this really annoys me. I don't remember even if I call and ask. When I'm busy, I can't tell whether I washed it or not. Since I wash the dishes first and then put them in the washing machine, they don't get dirty. I really hope the next product has a push mechanism after the automatic door opening or if it's hung like Miele. We've been complaining for two months because of that one mechanism.
Comments (Original): 3단인줄 알고 샀는데 2단이네요.칸 높이 조절이 가장 맘에 들어요.12인용은 밀레 이후 엘지가 첨인데요.밀레에 비해서 안 좋은건 딱 한가지.세척 끝나고 나면 밀레는 자동 문 열림 이후 문이 어딘가에 걸려 있거든요.그래서 내가 세척을 돌렸는지 바로 알 수 있어요.근데 엘지는 문 열고 그냥 그 밀림장치가 없어져 버려서 세척을 돌렸는지 안 돌렸는지 잘 몰라서 다시 그냥 아침에 돌리기도 해요.남편이랑 둘 다 바빠서 아침에 대화를 못하고 한명이 출근하게 되면 진짜 이것땜에 귀찮더라구요.전화해서 물어봐도 기억도 못하고...제 자신도 바쁠땐 돌렸는지 안 돌렸는지 구분이 잘 안가요.애벌을 하고 세척기에 넣기때문에 그릇들이 더럽지 않거든요.꼭 다음에 나오는 제품은 자동 문열림 이후에 밀림장치가 나와있다던지... 밀레처럼 걸려있던지 하면 좋을것 같아요.그 장치 하나땜에 2달 내내 둘다 툴툴 거리면서 생활 중이에요.

Sentence (English): Who knew a "labor saving" appliance could be so frustrating?
Comments (English): [ Hmmm.  ] || ---------------- || Who knew a "labor saving" appliance could be so frustrating? We waited 3 weeks for our WDT750SAKW0, hand washing during that time and were so looking forward to having a new dishwasher. Turns out I HATE the 3rd rack and the space it takes up, the way one must load dishes and the seeming lack of space to do so. Our 9 year old Kitchenaid died, but oh, how I miss it. This seems like the designers overthought the whole thing. Not intuitive, not enough room and almost 3 hours for a standard wash. Glassware doesn't happily fit with bowls and small plates on the 2nd rack, wine glasses are a problem. Weird. It does clean well, I will give it that. I like the controls on the top of the door so one's hindquarters don't accidentally start a cycle.

Sentence (English): This is hands down, the worst dishwasher I have ever owned.

I have had a number of dishwashers (various brands) over the years and this one is just terrible. The utensil baskets don't allow for adequate cleaning of the utensils and they even have worn spots in the racks which have begun to rust. I use a high quality detergent and rinse aid. All of these issues have been happening since the beginning of use and I have had 3 Samsung assigned technicians out to \"fix\" the issues and they continue. Samsung promised to replace or credit me for the dishwasher since it was failed to be fixed three times and then later reneged on this promise later when it came time to fulfill this promise. I am now stuck with a terrible product and will frankly, never purchase any type of samsung product again due to this poor product and terrible customer service. Please steer clear and purchase something else!

Sentence (English): We have had our dishwasher (Bosch 800 SHPM78Z54N) for about a month.
Comments (English): [ Seriously impressed ] || ---------------- || We have had our dishwasher (Bosch 800 SHPM78Z54N) for about a month. My husband and I did the installation ourselves with the adapter for hardwiring. Installation was as easy as could be for non-professionals with no issues. As for effectiveness, it's amazing! My husband was hesitant to get a new dishwasher as we have never had one that didn't require you to wash the dishes before washing the dishes (and yes, we had tried ALL THE THINGS to get other dishwashers to work). But this dishwasher has got the job done everytime, no rinsing required! I've almost started trying worse and worse pans to find what it can't get clean. So far, lasagna pans, burned on rice, dried on "whatever that is" (courtesy of our children keeping dishes in their rooms), et al. haven't been a match for this work horse. We consistently use the autocycle with Crystal dry and haven't tried the other settings. Crystal dry does a good enough job getting the dishes dry. It's not perfect, but better than other drying systems we've used. Everything is dry, with some water left on the top of mugs. I've read reviews that said the controls were difficult, but we haven't had a problem. Although, it did take a couple of tries to figure out that you only have a short amount of time after pushing the START button to close the door to get the cycle to start appropriately. We will see if it holds up over time, but for now, I'd buy it again in heartbeat!

It is anything but stainless - I have to be very careful to wipe the door after each loading to make sure no water or food has been left on the door, or it will stain. I would recommend this dishwasher only if you are prepared to have to fuss with door polishing.

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it is convenient and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. Since about 10 years have passed, it has definitely improved in terms of function and appearance. Before installation, the pre-installed dishwasher is in the form of a free standing + sink bottom cabinet. If you put Kitchen Fit in, you have to build a baseboard underneath. It may be cumbersome, but there were reasons that motivated me more than that, so I didn't worry too much about the baseboard. The dishwasher arrived on the same day, and the installer finished the skirting board with a material similar to ours. Both installers are very kind. Thank you. I am really satisfied. At first, many people were looking for a brand recommended by your *ber cafe or YouTube. In the end, the biggest reason for choosing Samsung was the . 1. Large-capacity dishwasher for 14 people. 2. Soaking is possible. There are three households living together, but since the family lives close by, we often have meals together, and during holidays, we gather at my house, so if the dishwasher is small, it's a hassle to wash it every time, so I unconditionally preferred the large one. The newly released Kitchen Fit 14-person Bespoke dishwasher is attractive in that it can store up to 110 dishes (depending on the shape and loading method of the dishes), and the top and middle racks can be moved, so the size is large. can store and wash a variety of tableware and cooking utensils. A cutting board is also included. good good And my daughter said that there is a small dishwasher that does not install at home, and that the function that she uses well is the steam cleaning function. Rice grains and sauce sticking to tableware are not only washed well, but also have the effect of sterilizing at high temperatures. So when I saw the phrase that Samsung has a soaking wash function, I was totally hooked. When you collect bowls and wash them at once, if you use the soaking function, you don't have to put water in the bowl. Hot steam comes out and soaks it, which helps in cleaning. In fact, after using it after purchase, I think I will be using this feature often in the future ~ . You can use it with confidence because it is sterilized and washed in hot water rather than washing by hand. In fact, even if there are many functions, there are a few functions that I use well. Rather than pressing multiple buttons, there is an ai customized course, so it's so convenient. Washing blades are also located at the top, middle and bottom, so cleaning is very neat. I don't like rinsing, so even though I used Nell* dishwasher detergent + rinse, the dishes shined! (Anyway, I think it will be cleaner if you wash the pot once and put it in.) . In addition, the hot air dries and the automatic door opens, so when you're done, just stay there for a while because you can store dishes in the sink right away. It is less time-consuming and more convenient than washing dishes by hand! I bought the Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher Kitchen Fit and washing the dishes is no longer burdensome. It's so convenient and nice. -- Participation in Samsung events.

Sentence (English): It was too much power, so I searched to buy a dishwasher again.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it is convenient and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it's convenient, but I don't think I can wash it clean. Just for interior use. It has been used and neglected for years. And then I have to exercise steadily due to health, but I can't do the dishes with my hands . It was too much power, so I searched to buy a dishwasher again. Since about 10 years have passed, it has definitely improved in terms of function and appearance. Before installation, the pre-installed dishwasher is in the form of a free standing + sink bottom cabinet. If you put Kitchen Fit in, you have to build a baseboard underneath. It may be cumbersome, but there were reasons that motivated me more than that, so I didn't worry too much about the baseboard. The dishwasher arrived on the same day, and the installer finished the skirting board with a material similar to ours. Both installers are very kind. Thank you. I am really satisfied. At first, many people were looking for a brand recommended by your *ber cafe or YouTube. In the end, the biggest reason for choosing Samsung was the . 1. Large-capacity dishwasher for 14 people. 2. Soaking is possible. There are three households living together, but since the family lives close by, we often have meals together, and during holidays, we gather at my house, so if the dishwasher is small, it's a hassle to wash it every time, so I unconditionally preferred the large one. The newly released Kitchen Fit 14-person Bespoke dishwasher is attractive in that it can store up to 110 dishes (depending on the shape and loading method of the dishes), and the top and middle racks can be moved, so the size is large. can store and wash a variety of tableware and cooking utensils. A cutting board is also included. good good And my daughter said that there is a small dishwasher that does not install at home, and that the function that she uses well is the steam cleaning function. Rice grains and sauce sticking to tableware are not only washed well, but also have the effect of sterilizing at high temperatures. So when I saw the phrase that Samsung has a soaking wash function, I was totally hooked. When you collect bowls and wash them at once, if you use the soaking function, you don't have to put water in the bowl. Hot steam comes out and soaks it, which helps in cleaning. In fact, after using it after purchase, I think I will be using this feature often in the future ~ . You can use it with confidence because it is sterilized and washed in hot water rather than washing by hand. In fact, even if there are many functions, there are a few functions that I use well. Rather than pressing multiple buttons, there is an ai customized course, so it's so convenient. Washing blades are also located at the top, middle and bottom, so cleaning is very neat. I don't like rinsing, so even though I used Nell* dishwasher detergent + rinse, the dishes shined! (Anyway, I think it will be cleaner if you wash the pot once and put it in.) . In addition, the hot air dries and the automatic door opens, so when you're done, just stay there for a while because you can store dishes in the sink right away. It is less time-consuming and more convenient than washing dishes by hand! I bought the Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher Kitchen Fit and washing the dishes is no longer burdensome. It's so convenient and nice. -- Participation in Samsung events.

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it is convenient and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. Since about 10 years have passed, it has definitely improved in terms of function and appearance. Before installation, the pre-installed dishwasher is in the form of a free standing + sink bottom cabinet. If you put Kitchen Fit in, you have to build a baseboard underneath. It may be cumbersome, but there were reasons that motivated me more than that, so I didn't worry too much about the baseboard. The dishwasher arrived on the same day, and the installer finished the skirting board with a material similar to ours. Both installers are very kind. Thank you. I am really satisfied. At first, many people were looking for a brand recommended by your *ber cafe or YouTube. In the end, the biggest reason for choosing Samsung was the . 1. Large-capacity dishwasher for 14 people. 2. Soaking is possible. There are three households living together, but since the family lives close by, we often have meals together, and during holidays, we gather at my house, so if the dishwasher is small, it's a hassle to wash it every time, so I unconditionally preferred the large one. The newly released Kitchen Fit 14-person Bespoke dishwasher is attractive in that it can store up to 110 dishes (depending on the shape and loading method of the dishes), and the top and middle racks can be moved, so the size is large. can store and wash a variety of tableware and cooking utensils. A cutting board is also included. good good And my daughter said that there is a small dishwasher that does not install at home, and that the function that she uses well is the steam cleaning function. Rice grains and sauce sticking to tableware are not only washed well, but also have the effect of sterilizing at high temperatures. So when I saw the phrase that Samsung has a soaking wash function, I was totally hooked. When you collect bowls and wash them at once, if you use the soaking function, you don't have to put water in the bowl. Hot steam comes out and soaks it, which helps in cleaning. In fact, after using it after purchase, I think I will be using this feature often in the future ~ . You can use it with confidence because it is sterilized and washed in hot water rather than washing by hand. In fact, even if there are many functions, there are a few functions that I use well. Rather than pressing multiple buttons, there is an ai customized course, so it's so convenient. Washing blades are also located at the top, middle and bottom, so cleaning is very neat. In addition, the hot air dries and the automatic door opens, so when you're done, just stay there for a while because you can store dishes in the sink right away. It's so convenient and nice. -- Participation in Samsung events.

Soaking is possible. Sentence (English): I am really satisfied.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it is convenient and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it's convenient, but I don't think I can wash it clean. Just for interior use. It has been used and neglected for years. Since about 10 years have passed, it has definitely improved in terms of function and appearance. Before installation, the pre-installed dishwasher is in the form of a free standing + sink bottom cabinet. If you put Kitchen Fit in, you have to build a baseboard underneath. It may be cumbersome, but there were reasons that motivated me more than that, so I didn't worry too much about the baseboard. The dishwasher arrived on the same day, and the installer finished the skirting board with a material similar to ours. Both installers are very kind. Thank you. I am really satisfied. At first, many people were looking for a brand recommended by your *ber cafe or YouTube. In the end, the biggest reason for choosing Samsung was the . 1. Large-capacity dishwasher for 14 people. 2. Soaking is possible. There are three households living together, but since the family lives close by, we often have meals together, and during holidays, we gather at my house, so if the dishwasher is small, it's a hassle to wash it every time, so I unconditionally preferred the large one. The newly released Kitchen Fit 14-person Bespoke dishwasher is attractive in that it can store up to 110 dishes (depending on the shape and loading method of the dishes), and the top and middle racks can be moved, so the size is large. can store and wash a variety of tableware and cooking utensils. A cutting board is also included. good good And my daughter said that there is a small dishwasher that does not install at home, and that the function that she uses well is the steam cleaning function. So when I saw the phrase that Samsung has a soaking wash function, I was totally hooked. In fact, after using it after purchase, I think I will be using this feature often in the future ~ . It's so convenient and nice. -- Participation in Samsung events.

Since about 10 years have passed, it has definitely improved in terms of function and appearance. Before installation, the pre-installed dishwasher is in the form of a free standing + sink bottom cabinet. If you put Kitchen Fit in, you have to build a baseboard underneath. It may be cumbersome, but there were reasons that motivated me more than that, so I didn't worry too much about the baseboard. The dishwasher arrived on the same day, and the installer finished the skirting board with a material similar to ours. Both installers are very kind. Thank you. I am really satisfied. At first, many people were looking for a brand recommended by your *ber cafe or YouTube. In the end, the biggest reason for choosing Samsung was the . 1. Large-capacity dishwasher for 14 people. 2. Soaking is possible. There are three households living together, but since the family lives close by, we often have meals together, and during holidays, we gather at my house, so if the dishwasher is small, it's a hassle to wash it every time, so I unconditionally preferred the large one. The newly released Kitchen Fit 14-person Bespoke dishwasher is attractive in that it can store up to 110 dishes (depending on the shape and loading method of the dishes), and the top and middle racks can be moved, so the size is large. can store and wash a variety of tableware and cooking utensils. A cutting board is also included. good good And my daughter said that there is a small dishwasher that does not install at home, and that the function that she uses well is the steam cleaning function. Rice grains and sauce sticking to tableware are not only washed well, but also have the effect of sterilizing at high temperatures. So when I saw the phrase that Samsung has a soaking wash function, I was totally hooked. When you collect bowls and wash them at once, if you use the soaking function, you don't have to put water in the bowl. Hot steam comes out and soaks it, which helps in cleaning. In fact, after using it after purchase, I think I will be using this feature often in the future ~ . In addition, the hot air dries and the automatic door opens, so when you're done, just stay there for a while because you can store dishes in the sink right away. It's so convenient and nice. -- Participation in Samsung events.

Sentence (English): I bought the Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher Kitchen Fit and washing the dishes is no longer burdensome.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it is convenient and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher I bought ten years ago. In fact, it's convenient, but I don't think I can wash it clean. Just for interior use. It has been used and neglected for years. And then I have to exercise steadily due to health, but I can't do the dishes with my hands . It was too much power, so I searched to buy a dishwasher again. Since about 10 years have passed, it has definitely improved in terms of function and appearance. Before installation, the pre-installed dishwasher is in the form of a free standing + sink bottom cabinet. If you put Kitchen Fit in, you have to build a baseboard underneath. It may be cumbersome, but there were reasons that motivated me more than that, so I didn't worry too much about the baseboard. The dishwasher arrived on the same day, and the installer finished the skirting board with a material similar to ours. Both installers are very kind. Thank you. I am really satisfied. At first, many people were looking for a brand recommended by your *ber cafe or YouTube. In the end, the biggest reason for choosing Samsung was the . 1. Large-capacity dishwasher for 14 people. 2. Soaking is possible. There are three households living together, but since the family lives close by, we often have meals together, and during holidays, we gather at my house, so if the dishwasher is small, it's a hassle to wash it every time, so I unconditionally preferred the large one. The newly released Kitchen Fit 14-person Bespoke dishwasher is attractive in that it can store up to 110 dishes (depending on the shape and loading method of the dishes), and the top and middle racks can be moved, so the size is large. can store and wash a variety of tableware and cooking utensils. A cutting board is also included. good good And my daughter said that there is a small dishwasher that does not install at home, and that the function that she uses well is the steam cleaning function. Rice grains and sauce sticking to tableware are not only washed well, but also have the effect of sterilizing at high temperatures. So when I saw the phrase that Samsung has a soaking wash function, I was totally hooked. When you collect bowls and wash them at once, if you use the soaking function, you don't have to put water in the bowl. Hot steam comes out and soaks it, which helps in cleaning. In fact, after using it after purchase, I think I will be using this feature often in the future ~ . You can use it with confidence because it is sterilized and washed in hot water rather than washing by hand. In fact, even if there are many functions, there are a few functions that I use well. Rather than pressing multiple buttons, there is an ai customized course, so it's so convenient. Washing blades are also located at the top, middle and bottom, so cleaning is very neat. I don't like rinsing, so even though I used Nell* dishwasher detergent + rinse, the dishes shined! (Anyway, I think it will be cleaner if you wash the pot once and put it in.) . In addition, the hot air dries and the automatic door opens, so when you're done, just stay there for a while because you can store dishes in the sink right away. It is less time-consuming and more convenient than washing dishes by hand! I bought the Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher Kitchen Fit and washing the dishes is no longer burdensome. It's so convenient and nice. -- Participation in Samsung events.

The electrical connection enclosure cover was another very sharp piece of metal. The cover fit was poor to the electrical back. The overall quality was just poor. Compared to the Maytag dishwasher I removed, the new tub wall thickness is thin causing the tub to be wobbly side to side.
