Sentence (English): Living alone is hard enough, but I also hate doing the dishes, so I chose this one.
Comments (English): [ A single-person household that feels innovative in kitchen appliances is using it. ] || ---------------- || Living alone is hard enough, but I also hate doing the dishes, so I chose this one. Size. I live in an officetel (so TMI-y). Anyway! It's just a regular size. It's perfect for an officetel! And to be precise, it can seat 2-3 people. It might be a bit tight for a full 3-person meal, but I think it's possible to wash the dishes for a simple meal for 3. It should be fine for a full 2-person meal. Design. It depends on the color, but I chose orange, but if I had to choose again, I think white would look better! That's not to say orange isn't pretty, but I think it would go well with a wood-toned kitchen. And the design itself is really simple and pretty. Functionality. First of all, what surprised me the most was that instead of automatic water filling, you have to manually fill the water. This is better than I thought. I'm still trying to decide where to put it, but I wanted to try it out, so I used the manual water filling method. I used it, and it took more water than I expected. And here's a tip! When you fill it with water, it beeps when it's full, but at first, it was a little slow to recognize the full capacity, so it didn't beep until the water overflowed. So, if you're using it for the first time, set it to exactly 5 liters and run it. After that, it beeps immediately when the water is full. Cleansing power. You might not believe it because it's so praised, but anyway! I put in cold water and it cleaned with fresh water. And the cleaning power is really good! I put in the blender lid, which is really hard to clean, and it cleaned well. Summary. The capacity for two people when fully filled seems to be accurate, and it's perfect for a two-person household. I recommend the white color, and it's working much better than I expected! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (Original): [ 주방가전에 혁신을 느끼는 1인가구가 쓰고있습니다 ] || ---------------- || 혼자사는것도 서러운데, 설거지까지 하기 서러워서 선택했습니다.크기.제가 오피스텔에 사는데(너무 TMI인데...) 암튼! 그냥 일반적인오피스텔에 두고 쓰기에 크기도 아주 적당해요!그리고 딱 말하면 2-3인용정도 됩니다.꽉찬 3인용까지는 조금 무리가 있어보이고, 간단한 3인분 식사치 설거지는 가능할것 같고꽉찬 2인용까지는 괜찬을거 같아요.디자인.색상마다 다르겠지만, 제가 선택한건 오렌지 색인데 만일 다시 선택하라고 하면화이트가 더 이쁠것 같아요! 그렇다고 오렌지 색상이 안이쁘다는건 아니지만주방이 우드톤이거나 그러면 잘어울릴것 같아요.그리고 디자인 자체가 되게 씸플하게 되어있어서 이쁩니다.기능.일단은 제가 가장 놀란게 자동급수가 아닌 수동으로 물을채워서 사용하는 방법이 있는데이게 생각보다 좋아요.저는 지금 어디에 두면 좋을까 고민중이긴한데, 그래도 한번써보고 싶어서 수동급수 방법으로사용했는데, 생각보다 물을 많이 넣어야 되요.그리고 팁하나 주자면!! 물을 넣다가 꽉차면 삑삑삑 거리는데, 처음에는 조금 인식하는데 늦어서 그런지물이 넘칠때까지 삑삑 안거리더라고요.그래서 만일 처음 사용할때는 일단은 5리터 딱 맞추고 가동해보고 그다음부터는 물이 꽉찼다고 바로 삑삑거리더라고요세정력.너무 칭찬이라서 못믿겠지만, 암튼! 냉수를 넣었는데 뜻뜻한물로 세척이 되더라고요.그리고 세정력 진짜 좋습니다!저는 진짜 세척하기 힘든 블랜더 뚜껑을 넣고 돌렸는데 깔끔하게 세척이 되었어요.정리.꽉찬 2인용이 정확한 용량같고, 2인가구가 쓰기에는 아주 좋다.색상은 화이트를 추천하고, 생각보다 아주 잘쓰고 있다! 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Sentence (English): Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently.
Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Sentence (English): Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. Comments (English): [ A compact yet powerful 3-person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recommend this to people like you. Those who need a dishwasher but move frequently. Those who are reluctant to drill holes. Those with small families or who don't have enough space for a dishwasher. I'm a two-person household. Since I work from home a lot, I naturally order a lot of delivery food. I love drinking tea, so I drink it often, which leads to a lot of water cups. Even if I don't cook often, spoons, dishes, and cups pile up. I was really debating whether to buy a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to buy one. ^^ It doesn't require installation, so there's no need to worry. ^^ Size. The box arrived larger than I expected. Opening it, I found that it's a fairly compact size for a three-person dishwasher. ^^ Of course, it won't fit frying pans or pots, and neither will a six-person dishwasher. There are various wash cycles (standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam). I loaded cups, spoons, plates, bowls, and cooking utensils and ran it on standard mode. It takes about an hour. Ah, they say you have to turn it on and pour in water to prevent it from breaking. Also, make sure it's level. Since it's a water-filled, spinning system, it's a bit noisier than one with a water supply. Regarding cleaning power, I'm concerned about food scraps remaining in the drain, so I rinse it with a larva before putting it in. Even a 3-person mini shouldn't be underestimated. ^^. The water sprays up and down to thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. It makes a really squeaky sound. Cups in particular are much more thoroughly cleaned than washing them by hand. Once the washing is complete, it runs for 75.5 hours until you open the door. You'll hear a humming sound and the air will blow. I open the door halfway through to dry the inside as well. I use a water tank for the water supply. It's not a huge hassle for me, but if you're concerned, you can add water directly using a faucet. Self-installation is also possible. When the water tank inside is full, it will beep and stop supplying water. It can be washed at high temperatures of 72 degrees and can also be sterilized with steam, so it would be good to use it exclusively for sterilizing baby bottles. I was looking for a 6-person dishwasher, so I tried it out and was thinking of giving it to a friend who lives alone, but it's so good that I'm going to keep using it myself^^. Now, I think I'd be upset if I didn't have a dishwasher^^. It seems to have become a part of my life now. I even recommended it to a friend who lives alone^^. I haven't yet figured out how to fit a dinner plate into each slot of the lower rack, the way the owner's manual shows,  and still be able to slide both racks fully into the machine.  As a result, my recommendation applies only to people who require an under-the-sink dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I chose this model because it was so well rated.
Comments (English): [ Hurdles at the beginning ] || ---------------- || I chose this model because it was so well rated. The first 2 or 3 washes had a dusty film on them; Bosch needs to tell us to run it through empty a few times first. I've been on the website and watched several videos but wish there was one explaining the cycles and resetting them. Love the storage racks - the middle rack is height-adjustable and the top is great for small, lightly soiled items. Using the tall stemware feature was good but takes up a lot of room by angling my glasses to fit and need more notches in the flip down aide. Would have liked a bigger cutlery basket but like how the grid keeps items separated for better cleaning. Registering the product was not easy - the QR code is on the side door and couldn't be accessed once installed (next to a cornered cabinet). So I ripped that decal off -not easy, to scan and text the icon; it didn't work (? maybe not applicable to Canada? ). Which left me with phoning it in and that went well. After a few months the dishwasher is tipping forward -yikes! If I pull the loaded bottom rack out the whole unit tips forward. Obviously not installed correctly with long enough screws to anchor into the top counter, and may be the professional installer's fault and not Bosch's. Now things have smoothed out and I am enjoying it more.

Sentence (English): I did a lot of research trying to find a dishwasher that would fit my limited sized opening and would have the features I wanted.
Comments (English): [ Love the features, but I'm not sold ] || ---------------- || I did a lot of research trying to find a dishwasher that would fit my limited sized opening and would have the features I wanted. Features wise, this dishwasher has it all. I have to say, however, that I wish I had my old dishwasher back. My main disappointment is that it doesn't seem to fit a lot of dishes. It had one of the highest rating for amount of place settings it would fit, but it just seems significantly smaller than our old dishwasher. It also boasted of smooth rolling top rack. In reality, it seems rickety and cheap. The other feature that caught my attention was the dry boost feature. I loved the idea of not having to dry plastic items at the end of a wash. While this does help, they still come out wet. One other thing that was weird about this dishwasher. The tines on the bottom rack don't line up well. It causes my larger plates to go in crooked. I don't know if this last item is a defect or intentional, but my wife and I sat staring at it asking "Why? ". Outside of that, it's moderately quiet, but not impressively so. Also, this is my first time having a 3rd upper rack. I've put a few things in it, but mostly I find it a waste of space. We frequently forget to even check it when unloading. I think it will work well for large tongs, knives, and spatulas, but you don't need it for silverware as you have the silverware basket below. On the positive side, it does a good job washing, and the upper rack adjust up and down easily. And I love the idea of being able to do a half load (we haven't tried this yet), but given the fact that it doesn't hold a lot of dishes, we may never need it. I hope these comments help in your research!

In reality, it seems rickety and cheap.  The other feature that caught my attention was the dry boost feature.  I loved the idea of not having to dry plastic items at the end of a wash.  While this does help, they still come out wet.  One other thing that was weird about this dishwasher.  The tines on the bottom rack don't line up well.  It causes my larger plates to go in crooked.  I don't know if this last item is a defect or intentional, but my wife and I sat staring at it asking 'Why???'.Outside of that, it's moderately quiet, but not impressively so.  Also, this is my first time having a 3rd upper rack.  I've put a few things in it, but mostly I find it a waste of space.  We frequently forget to even check it when unloading.  I think it will work well for large tongs, knives, and spatulas, but you don't need it for silverware as you have the silverware basket below.On the positive side, it does a good job washing, and the upper rack adjust up and down easily.  And I love the idea of being able to do a half load (we haven't tried this yet), but given the fact that it doesn't hold a lot of dishes, we may never need it.I hope these comments help in your research!

Sentence (English): This replaces a 16 year old Kenmore.
Comments (English): [ Bought for features, several small install issues ] || ---------------- || This replaces a 16 year old Kenmore. Purchased for the water saving features and newer overall tech. The supplied "insulation blanket" looked more like some packing material. Was just draped over the washer, not attached like the Kenmore - and not as thick. The toe kick insulation, if that's what it was, had to be attached with glue. No other way to attach the foam to the toe kick, or under the unit. The supplied extension drain hose end was a bit big for the standard size disposal port and required scaring up a worm clamp. Not all the adjustment feet were tapped square to the frame. Not a huge issue since the floor is tile, but still it looked "lame" to have some feet come down at an angle. The user part of the manual is short and sweet, only minimal info. No discussion of features. We played with the keypanel and yucked with the baskets to figure things out. I am still intrigued with the RJ45 port under the unit - ? Plus side - it is quiet, more than the old unit (which was big $ when bought). Will see how the water clarity features and split level wash work, but should save us $. Water is high buck here. Other that the irritating install issues, it's overall a decent machine. Advice - level the unit and test fit in the cabinet location before hooking it up. You'll be tipping it over a bunch to mess with the feet, and the drain hose will constantly flop in your way when sliding it in.

I was actually happy that it had broken because as long as I had used it , it never cleaned the dishes! I just wanted a Bosch again! I am impressed! It's not the style or model that I wanted , but it sure does a wonderful job! It's still quiet and on the positive side , I saved a whole lot of money! The one that I currently have is a 300 model. Just a great machine. Thank you again Bosch!

Just a great machine. Thank you again Bosch!

Have owned many dishwashers through the years but never thought I would ever be compelled to return one or write a review because I didn't like it! (One explanation I saw was that this is designed for European market so dishes are a different size - rubbish! As a Brit living in US there is no difference in the sizes). As other people have mentioned the angled tines on the top rack are the problem. Because of this, a standard high ball glass is impossible to load without having to lay it almost flat. I could load at most 5 of these glasses on their side across multiple tines in this dishwasher leaving no space for anything else. Also the plate tines on the bottom are too close together making it incredibly difficult again to load plates and loading bowls almost impossible. The third rack bumps into the top rack if you try to stand your regulars glasses up so you lower the rack and now it bumps into you bottom rack plates because they are so upright because of the close tines! Also, as mentioned in other reviews, the bottom rack base grid is so large that items just fall through, so if you have fully loaded that top rack and you want to throw in that last mug or glass on the bottom not possible! Truly the worst design! Didn't think it was possible to mess up something so bad by a company known for its design.

Now things have smoothed out and I am enjoying it more.

The first 2 or 3 washes had a dusty film on them; Bosch needs to tell us to run it through empty a few times first. I've been on the website and watched several videos but wish there was one explaining the cycles and resetting them. Love the storage racks - the middle rack is height-adjustable and the top is great for small, lightly soiled items. Using the tall stemware feature was good but takes up a lot of room by angling my glasses to fit and need more notches in the flip down aide. Would have liked a bigger cutlery basket but like how the grid keeps items separated for better cleaning. Registering the product was not easy - the QR code is on the side door and couldn't be accessed once installed (next to a cornered cabinet). After a few months the dishwasher is tipping forward -yikes! If I pull the loaded bottom rack out the whole unit tips forward. Obviously not installed correctly with long enough screws to anchor into the top counter, and may be the professional installer's fault and not Bosch's. Now things have smoothed out and I am enjoying it more.

Sentence (English): In busy times like these, a dishwasher is a must.

As expected, it was much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I saw my sister using a dishwasher and thought, "Why bother using a dishwasher when you can just wash a few dishes by hand?"
Comments (English): [ Washing the dishes in the dishwasher ~ I have the luxury of a cup of coffee ] || ---------------- || I saw my sister using a dishwasher and thought, "Why bother using a dishwasher when you can just wash a few dishes by hand?" Rather than feeling envious, I thought it was a waste of money. My sister's dishwasher has a large capacity, so instead of washing dishes right away, she collects them and does them all at once. I got a great deal on Coupang and started using a dishwasher. Since I already had it, I bought the dishwasher detergent and used it right away. For a family of four, after a meal, it can easily hold 4 bowls, 3-4 plates, spoons, and the occasional soup bowl. - Unlike a regular dishwasher, you have to pour the water yourself. You can pour it into the included water tank about 3 times when you start it, so it's not too inconvenient. = It washes with hot water (72 degrees Celsius). I poured cold water, and it quickly heated up to 72 degrees Celsius and washed the dishes. Washing with hot water seems to remove grease. The Media dishwasher has a transparent window, so you can see everything being washed. You can see powerful water jets spraying from above and below, thoroughly cleaning every nook and cranny. I checked to see if it was working, and wow! It came out really clean and tidy. The only downside to the Media dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only need to pour it in when you first start it. - It automatically beeps when the water level is full, so there's no need to worry about overflow. The water tray makes it easy to add water and prevents it from overflowing. Unlike larger dishwashers, you don't have to store all the dishes in one go; you can wash them right after eating. - It has wheels for easy loading and unloading. - It has five standard functions: strong, eco-friendly, and rapid steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes the dishes, making even a cup of coffee feel more leisurely and enjoyable. It would be even better for a home with a baby. It's so convenient for washing baby bottles. This media dishwasher is highly recommended for its compact size, quick-cleaning capabilities, and minimal clutter. It's so convenient for washing baby bottles. This media dishwasher is highly recommended for its compact size, quick-cleaning capabilities, and minimal clutter. I checked to see if it was working, and wow! It came out really clean and tidy. The only downside to the Media dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes the dishes, making even a cup of coffee feel more leisurely and enjoyable. It would be even better for a home with a baby. It's so convenient for washing baby bottles. This media dishwasher is highly recommended for its compact size, quick-cleaning capabilities, and minimal clutter. I poured cold water, and it quickly heated up to 72 degrees Celsius and washed the dishes. Washing with hot water seems to remove grease. I checked to see if it was working, and wow! It came out really clean and tidy. The only downside to the Media dishwasher is that you have to pour the water yourself, but that's not inconvenient. You only need to pour it in when you first start it. - It automatically beeps when the water level is full, so there's no need to worry about overflow. Unlike larger dishwashers, you don't have to store all the dishes in one go; you can wash them right after eating. - It has wheels for easy loading and unloading. - It has five standard functions: strong, eco-friendly, and rapid steam. It washes, rinses, dries, and sterilizes the dishes, making even a cup of coffee feel more leisurely and enjoyable. It would be even better for a home with a baby. It's so convenient for washing baby bottles. This media dishwasher is highly recommended for its compact size, quick-cleaning capabilities, and minimal clutter. Sentence (English): In addition to my existing six-person dishwasher, I recently purchased a mini dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and great for a single-person household. ] || ---------------- || In addition to my existing six-person dishwasher, I recently purchased a mini dishwasher. Even though it's a mini, it's compact and powerful. It's definitely small enough to fit comfortably in my hand. It's packed with features, so I find myself reaching for it more often than my six-person dishwasher. For reference, I live alone and only cook light dinners on weekdays, so I don't usually have a lot of dishes to wash. Sometimes, when I get hooked, I'll diligently cook and end up with a lot of dishes, but that's not often, so I've been craving a mini dishwasher. Coming home from work, I'm always pressed for time, and the dishwashing time would always be taken away. It used to be exhausting, but now I have some free time, which is great. Since it's optimized for two- to three-person households, I don't like bulky appliances and if you wash dishes frequently, this will be a great help. I'll write a detailed review. *Delivery and installation. It was packaged in thick Styrofoam to prevent damage during shipping. The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. The shipping box felt a bit heavy, but once I unpacked it and moved it, it felt just right, and it was easy to carry. It's a simple, no-installation product. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. It holds about 5 liters, but fill the included water container. Pour it through the water inlet tray, and it will drain smoothly without spilling. Then, select the menu and press the button. Before using, place the dishes face down, as the water sprays from the bottom. While the water sprays from the top, the wider bottom makes it much more convenient to place them upside down. It automatically washes and dries at 72°C (172°F) and is very efficient. The drying function is really convenient and great. After the dryer is finished, the timer function cycles between pauses and pauses. If you don't want it to, you can open the door after it's finished and it's dry enough. *Functions. This little machine has quite a variety of functions. The menu is more varied than I expected, and the transparent window makes it fun to look at. It also has a steam sterilization function and a full-circulation air drying system. After washing, it even handles drying and storage functions, which is very convenient. The internal fan cycles between pauses and pauses after the dryer is finished, providing continuous airflow for 72 hours. This allows for odor-free, clean drying and storage of dishes. It can also be used as a dish drying rack. Despite its compact size, the two-stage upper and lower 9-stage, high-temperature, high-pressure 360-degree water spray ensures thorough cleaning. I put my dishes in with the red grease still on, and they came out perfectly clean. I just remove the larger pieces and put them back in. The steam function allows for a 30-minute high-temperature wash, which is a nice bonus. It leaves dishes sparkling clean and sparkling. Among the standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam functions, I often use the strong setting. I had dishwasher detergent on hand, so I used that. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and great for a single-person household. ] || ---------------- || In addition to my existing six-person dishwasher, I recently purchased a mini dishwasher. Even though it's a mini, it's compact and powerful. It's definitely small enough to fit comfortably in my hand. It's packed with features, so I find myself reaching for it more often than my six-person dishwasher. For reference, I live alone and only cook light dinners on weekdays, so I don't usually have a lot of dishes to wash. Sometimes, when I get hooked, I'll diligently cook and end up with a lot of dishes, but that's not often, so I've been craving a mini dishwasher. Coming home from work, I'm always pressed for time, and the dishwashing time would always be taken away. It used to be exhausting, but now I have some free time, which is great. Since it's optimized for two- to three-person households, I don't like bulky appliances and if you wash dishes frequently, this will be a great help. I'll write a detailed review. *Delivery and installation. It was packaged in thick Styrofoam to prevent damage during shipping. The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. The shipping box felt a bit heavy, but once I unpacked it and moved it, it felt just right, and it was easy to carry. It's a simple, no-installation product. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. It holds about 5 liters, but fill the included water container. Pour it through the water inlet tray, and it will drain smoothly without spilling. Then, select the menu and press the button. Before using, place the dishes face down, as the water sprays from the bottom. While the water sprays from the top, the wider bottom makes it much more convenient to place them upside down. It automatically washes and dries at 72°C (172°F) and is very efficient. The drying function is really convenient and great. After the dryer is finished, the timer function cycles between pauses and pauses. If you don't want it to, you can open the door after it's finished and it's dry enough. *Functions. This little machine has quite a variety of functions. The menu is more varied than I expected, and the transparent window makes it fun to look at. It also has a steam sterilization function and a full-circulation air drying system. After washing, it even handles drying and storage functions, which is very convenient. The internal fan cycles between pauses and pauses after the dryer is finished, providing continuous airflow for 72 hours. This allows for odor-free, clean drying and storage of dishes. It can also be used as a dish drying rack. Despite its compact size, the two-stage upper and lower 9-stage, high-temperature, high-pressure 360-degree water spray ensures thorough cleaning. I put my dishes in with the red grease still on, and they came out perfectly clean. I just remove the larger pieces and put them back in. The steam function allows for a 30-minute high-temperature wash, which is a nice bonus. It leaves dishes sparkling clean and sparkling. Among the standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam functions, I often use the strong setting. I had dishwasher detergent on hand, so I used that. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and great for a single-person household. ] || ---------------- || In addition to my existing six-person dishwasher, I recently purchased a mini dishwasher. For reference, I live alone and only cook light dinners on weekdays, so I don't usually have a lot of dishes to wash. Coming home from work, I'm always pressed for time, and the dishwashing time would always be taken away. It used to be exhausting, but now I have some free time, which is great. Since it's optimized for two- to three-person households, I don't like bulky appliances and if you wash dishes frequently, this will be a great help. I'll write a detailed review. *Delivery and installation. It was packaged in thick Styrofoam to prevent damage during shipping. The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. The shipping box felt a bit heavy, but once I unpacked it and moved it, it felt just right, and it was easy to carry. It's a simple, no-installation product. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. It holds about 5 liters, but fill the included water container. Pour it through the water inlet tray, and it will drain smoothly without spilling. Then, select the menu and press the button. Before using, place the dishes face down, as the water sprays from the bottom. While the water sprays from the top, the wider bottom makes it much more convenient to place them upside down. It automatically washes and dries at 72°C (172°F) and is very efficient. The drying function is really convenient and great. After the dryer is finished, the timer function cycles between pauses and pauses. If you don't want it to, you can open the door after it's finished and it's dry enough. *Functions. This little machine has quite a variety of functions. The menu is more varied than I expected, and the transparent window makes it fun to look at. It also has a steam sterilization function and a full-circulation air drying system. After washing, it even handles drying and storage functions, which is very convenient. The internal fan cycles between pauses and pauses after the dryer is finished, providing continuous airflow for 72 hours. This allows for odor-free, clean drying and storage of dishes. It can also be used as a dish drying rack. Despite its compact size, the two-stage upper and lower 9-stage, high-temperature, high-pressure 360-degree water spray ensures thorough cleaning. I put my dishes in with the red grease still on, and they came out perfectly clean. I just remove the larger pieces and put them back in. The steam function allows for a 30-minute high-temperature wash, which is a nice bonus. It leaves dishes sparkling clean and sparkling. Among the standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam functions, I often use the strong setting. I had dishwasher detergent on hand, so I used that. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and great for a single-person household. ] || ---------------- || In addition to my existing six-person dishwasher, I recently purchased a mini dishwasher. Even though it's a mini, it's compact and powerful. It's definitely small enough to fit comfortably in my hand. It's packed with features, so I find myself reaching for it more often than my six-person dishwasher. For reference, I live alone and only cook light dinners on weekdays, so I don't usually have a lot of dishes to wash. Sometimes, when I get hooked, I'll diligently cook and end up with a lot of dishes, but that's not often, so I've been craving a mini dishwasher. Coming home from work, I'm always pressed for time, and the dishwashing time would always be taken away. It used to be exhausting, but now I have some free time, which is great. Since it's optimized for two- to three-person households, I don't like bulky appliances and if you wash dishes frequently, this will be a great help. I'll write a detailed review. *Delivery and installation. It was packaged in thick Styrofoam to prevent damage during shipping. The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. The shipping box felt a bit heavy, but once I unpacked it and moved it, it felt just right, and it was easy to carry. It's a simple, no-installation product. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. It holds about 5 liters, but fill the included water container. Pour it through the water inlet tray, and it will drain smoothly without spilling. Then, select the menu and press the button. Before using, place the dishes face down, as the water sprays from the bottom. While the water sprays from the top, the wider bottom makes it much more convenient to place them upside down. It automatically washes and dries at 72°C (172°F) and is very efficient. The drying function is really convenient and great. After the dryer is finished, the timer function cycles between pauses and pauses. If you don't want it to, you can open the door after it's finished and it's dry enough. *Functions. This little machine has quite a variety of functions. The menu is more varied than I expected, and the transparent window makes it fun to look at. It also has a steam sterilization function and a full-circulation air drying system. After washing, it even handles drying and storage functions, which is very convenient. The internal fan cycles between pauses and pauses after the dryer is finished, providing continuous airflow for 72 hours. This allows for odor-free, clean drying and storage of dishes. It can also be used as a dish drying rack. Despite its compact size, the two-stage upper and lower 9-stage, high-temperature, high-pressure 360-degree water spray ensures thorough cleaning. I put my dishes in with the red grease still on, and they came out perfectly clean. I just remove the larger pieces and put them back in. The steam function allows for a 30-minute high-temperature wash, which is a nice bonus. It leaves dishes sparkling clean and sparkling. Among the standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam functions, I often use the strong setting. I had dishwasher detergent on hand, so I used that. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and great for a single-person household. ] || ---------------- || In addition to my existing six-person dishwasher, I recently purchased a mini dishwasher. Even though it's a mini, it's compact and powerful. It's definitely small enough to fit comfortably in my hand. It's packed with features, so I find myself reaching for it more often than my six-person dishwasher. For reference, I live alone and only cook light dinners on weekdays, so I don't usually have a lot of dishes to wash. Sometimes, when I get hooked, I'll diligently cook and end up with a lot of dishes, but that's not often, so I've been craving a mini dishwasher. Coming home from work, I'm always pressed for time, and the dishwashing time would always be taken away. It used to be exhausting, but now I have some free time, which is great. Since it's optimized for two- to three-person households, I don't like bulky appliances and if you wash dishes frequently, this will be a great help. I'll write a detailed review. *Delivery and installation. It was packaged in thick Styrofoam to prevent damage during shipping. The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. The shipping box felt a bit heavy, but once I unpacked it and moved it, it felt just right, and it was easy to carry. It's a simple, no-installation product. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. It holds about 5 liters, but fill the included water container. Pour it through the water inlet tray, and it will drain smoothly without spilling. Then, select the menu and press the button. Before using, place the dishes face down, as the water sprays from the bottom. While the water sprays from the top, the wider bottom makes it much more convenient to place them upside down. It automatically washes and dries at 72°C (172°F) and is very efficient. The drying function is really convenient and great. After the dryer is finished, the timer function cycles between pauses and pauses. If you don't want it to, you can open the door after it's finished and it's dry enough. *Functions. This little machine has quite a variety of functions. The menu is more varied than I expected, and the transparent window makes it fun to look at. It also has a steam sterilization function and a full-circulation air drying system. After washing, it even handles drying and storage functions, which is very convenient. It can also be used as a dish drying rack. Despite its compact size, the two-stage upper and lower 9-stage, high-temperature, high-pressure 360-degree water spray ensures thorough cleaning. I put my dishes in with the red grease still on, and they came out perfectly clean. I just remove the larger pieces and put them back in. The steam function allows for a 30-minute high-temperature wash, which is a nice bonus. It leaves dishes sparkling clean and sparkling. Among the standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam functions, I often use the strong setting. I had dishwasher detergent on hand, so I used that. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. It automatically washes and dries at 72°C (172°F) and is very efficient. The drying function is really convenient and great. After the dryer is finished, the timer function cycles between pauses and pauses. If you don't want it to, you can open the door after it's finished and it's dry enough. *Functions. Among the standard, strong, eco, quick, and steam functions, I often use the strong setting. I had dishwasher detergent on hand, so I used that. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! The shipping box was a bit large, but it was wrapped with string, so it was easy to bring it inside. Simply attach the drain hose and position it. Seeing the included water hose, I wondered if it could be automatically watered. I can't extend the line under the sink any further, so I'm using manual watering. The simple installation is a plus. *How to use: Turn on the power and pour water into the top until it beeps. I put my dishes in with the red grease still on, and they came out perfectly clean. I just remove the larger pieces and put them back in. The steam function allows for a 30-minute high-temperature wash, which is a nice bonus. It leaves dishes sparkling clean and sparkling. Even though I split it into quarters, it still felt like a lot, so I was thinking about reducing the amount of detergent. I think it would be better if the powder detergent was poured separately, because it would be easier to control. It washes away even grease well and dries well. I use it every day! Sentence (English): I really regret buying a dishwasher, I regret not buying it sooner.
Comments (English): I really regret buying a dishwasher, I regret not buying it sooner. The dishes are washed very clean, and the teacups and glasses are even cleaner than washing themselves, which can wash away the tea stains. Pots are slightly less clean, but acceptable. The capacity is large, once eleven people had a meal, except for the pan, the rest can be put down, and the same can be washed clean. It didn't smell bad the next day. But there are two obvious disadvantages: hand washing requires steel wool to clean the dishes or pots, and the dishwasher is not clean enough, so it is not recommended to wash them, such as steaming eggs with stainless steel dishes. After washing the dishes, they are not completely dry, and some places are still wet. This is the biggest shortcoming. I hope Siemens will improve it in the future.
Comments (Original): 买了洗碗机真后悔，后悔没早买。碗碗碟碟洗的很干净，茶杯、玻璃杯甚至比自己洗得更干净，能洗掉茶渍。锅具清洗干净程度略差点，但可以接受。容量大，有次十一个人吃饭，除了锅具放不下外，其余的全部可放下，一样洗得干净。第二天拿出来没异味。但有两个明显的缺点:手洗需要钢丝球才能洗干净的碟或锅，洗碗机洗得不够干净，不建议拿去洗，如用不锈钢碟蒸蛋。洗完碗之后，不完全干，有些地方还是湿的，这点是最大的缺点，希望西门子以后改进。

Unless you are the one who loaded it and washed the dishes you can never tell if they are clean or dirty. We always rinse our dishes so there is never food on them when we put them in the dishwasher, so it's hard to tell if they have been washed or not. The light needs to stay on when they are clean so you know. Also it is not easy to tell if the drying feature is on or off. Plastic things don't dry all the way even when it's on dry so it's hard to tell without going into the settings to see if the drying feature is on or off. Otherwise it's a nice quiet dishwasher. Not as big inside as my old one (I could put cookie sheets in my old one, this one I can't), but still great.

We notified KitchenAid during the warranty period and they sent out a local appliance team to help rectify the issue. They had to come out on 5 different occasions. Despite replacing part of the door, this did not rectify the problem. On the last visit we were told that the KitchenAid engineers told the appliance company that the dishwasher is working as intended and there was nothing to fix. We are really disappointed because otherwise the unit cleans so well and is whisper quiet. Unfortunately, we recommend avoiding this dishwasher.

Comments (Original): [ 삶의 질 향상 내 시간 확보 세척력 좋은 식기세척기 ] || ---------------- || 설거지하는 것을 좋아해서 딱히 식기세척기에 대한 필요성을 느끼지 못했었던 1인입니다.신랑이 설거지를 싫어해서, 제가 다 도맡아서 하다보니 맞벌이인데 점차 집안일에 지쳐가고 있었습니다.주변에서 식기세척기가 정말 좋다는 이야기들을 많이 들어서, 식기세척기를 한 번 써볼까 생각하고 미디어 2~3인용 식기세척기를 선택하게 되었는데요.결론부터 말씀드리면, 처음 쓰자마자 설거지를 딱히 싫어하지 않았던 저조차도 더 깨끗하게 설거지를 해주는 식세기에 반해버렸습니다.보통 설거지 한 번 하면 20~30분 정도 소요되는데, 많으면 하루에 2번 정도 설거지를 하기 때문에, 1주일로 했을때 몇시간의 시간을 줄일 수 있게 됩니다.내 시간을 더 가질 수 있으니 이보다 더 좋을 수 없어요!식기세척기용 세제는 따로 구매해야하는데, 적정용량이 6g 이므로, 이에 맞춰서 나온 제품으로 구매하시면 되요!2~3인 가구가 쓰기 매우 적합하고, 구성도 알차게 되어있습니다.우유병을 넣을 수 있는 거치대, 작은 그릇들을 올릴 수 있게 추가로 설치해서 사용하도록 되어 있어서 좋았습니다.<설치방법>여자 혼자 설치하기도 쉬웠는데, 생각보다 무거워서 싱크대 위에 올려놓는 것만 힘들었지, 그 후에 설치하는 것은 쉬웠습니다.제일 먼저, 안에 있는 내용물을 다 꺼낸 뒤에, 배수호스를 뒤에 배수부분에 연결합니다.혹시나 배수호스가 빠지지 않도록 고정할 수 있는 클리퍼가 같이 오기 때문에, 최대한 꽉 조여서 고정시켜주세요!그리고 수동급수, 자동급수를 선택하여 설치할 수 있는데, 설명서에 나와있지 않아서 폭풍검색을 했어요.수동급수는 같이 동봉된 물받이와 물통으로 상단에 위치한 물 급수 구멍에 넣어주면 되는데요.<자동급수 설치 방법>자동급수 호스도 같이 오기 때문에, 세탁기처럼 연결해서 자동급수를 사용할 수 있어요.저희 집에는 예전에 정수기 사용하다가 안 쓰게 되서 남은 정수기 호스가 싱크대 수전에 연결이 되어 있었는데요.그 부분에 정수기 연결 부속(수나사 보통 15A, 6mm - 21mm)를 연결하면 자동급수 설치도 혼자 설치할 수 있습니다.아직 부품이 오지 않았는데, 인터넷에 검색해보면 미디어 식기세척기를 사용하는 사람들이 많아 자동급수 설치하는 방법들이 다양하게 나와있으니 딱맞는 방법으로 설치하시면 될 것 같아요.***업데이트***자동급수 설치 성공했습니다!! 작동이 아주 잘 되고, 직접 물통으로 수동급수하는 것보다 시간도 엄청 단축되고 빨리 급수되니 삶의 질이 더욱 향상되었어요!! 자동급수 설치 꼭 도전해보시길 강추합니다!<사용방법>그릇은 서로 닿지 않도록 넣어주는 것이 깨지지 않는데 도움이 된다고 해요.또 그릇 방향을 비스듬하게 넣어야, 위아래로 물이 나오기 때문에 세척이 잘 됩니다.컵도 잘 씻겨지고, 숟가락 젓가락도 아주 잘 세척됩니다.조심해야하는 점은, 날카로운 물체는 넣지 말아야 해요. 고장날 수도 있어요!1. 구매이유 - 삶의 질 향상을 위해서- 설거지 집안일이 점차 버겁게 느껴져서- 내 시간을 조금이라도 아끼고 싶어서- 주부습진에서 벗어나고 싶어서2. 장점 및 특징- 세척력이 좋음- 생각보다 많이 들어감- 소음이 세탁기보다 적은 정도라 엄청 크진 않음- 물을 아낄 수 있음. 보통 설거지하면 물을 훨씬 더 많이 쓴다고 해요. 5~6L로 다 세척해주니까 물도 아낄 수 있어 환경오염이 적습니다!- 내가 세척하는 것보다 훨씬 깨끗하게 세척됨- 여자 혼자서도 설치하기 쉬움- 수동급수 뿐만 아니라 자동급수로 설치하는 것이 가능함3. 단점딱히 없습니다.저의 리뷰가 도움이 되셨다면, 정말 좋겠습니다:)도움이 되셨다면 ♥도움이돼요♥ 버튼 꾹 눌러주세요! 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.
